contents.name: Definition 2.36: universal-Sigma^0_alpha and universal-Pi^0_alpha subsets of Y x X
contents.reason: Parameterised universal sets are descriptive-set-theory machinery; the library has not reached that subject area, and MT-1 needs only the strictness conclusion of Corollary 2.38, which it cites as an external dependency.

contents.name: Lemma 2.37: for a separable metric space X and every alpha with 1 < alpha < omega_1 there is a Sigma^0_alpha-universal and a Pi^0_alpha-universal subset of C x X
contents.reason: The construction of universal sets over the Cantor space is the descriptive-set-theory prerequisite for the diagonal argument; it belongs to a subject area the library has not reached, and is exactly the machinery whose absence makes rem-the-borel-hierarchy-never-stabilizes a proved_here: false record.

contents.name: Corollary 2.38: for an uncountable Polish space X and every alpha < omega_1, Sigma^0_alpha(X) is not Pi^0_alpha(X); in particular Sigma^0_alpha(X) is a proper subset of Delta^0_{alpha+1}(X), so the Borel hierarchy is strict through omega_1 levels
